version.description: Pins this module: X.Y.Z exactly, X.Y or X to the newest release within it. Omitted, the newest release (LIB-0023 §3).

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

cockpit.description: Cockpit/Alloy wiring (ADR-0102). null disables Alloy entirely -- no apt repo, no config.alloy, no PIGEON_LOG_DIR.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

enable_transcoding.description: Install a pinned, checksum-verified static ffmpeg 9.0.2 build into /usr/local/bin, for job commands that run `pigeon-cli transform` (ADR-0150, renamed by ADR-0151, reworked by ADR-0152). A static build is used rather than any apt package because grid-tiled HEIF images are only reconstructed by the ffmpeg CLI from 8.1 onwards, and no Ubuntu archive reaches that floor while every savoury1 PPA above ffmpeg4 needs a donation-gated private PPA. The pinned artifact is an x86_64 (linux64) binary: do not enable this for an arm64 instance type such as COPARM1-*.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

has_attached_volume.description: Whether a block volume is attached to this instance, which adds the mkfs/mount//etc/fstab steps for /dev/sdb at /mnt/data. A plain bool rather than the volume's ID, deliberately: the volume is created by the caller (ADR-0153), and a bool keeps the rendered document independent of apply-time-unknown values.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

keyring.description: pigeon-cli keyring.toml entries, written to /root/.config/pigeon/keyring.toml (0600) with each secret in it: secret on an email identity, secret_key on a bucket (LIB-0018). Email entries require email, provider, host, port and secret; bucket entries require endpoint, bucket, access_key_id and secret_key. No rclone.conf is rendered and no PIGEON_SECRET_<ALIAS> is exported: pigeon-cli generates its own rclone.conf beside the keyring from the bucket entries.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

keyring_secrets.description: Per-alias keyring fields that are secrets, merged over keyring and keyring_wiring by alias (LIB-0043 §4): a workload's secretRefs, resolved. Each inner key is a string field of the entry: email, host, secret, endpoint, bucket, access_key_id or secret_key. Every key must be an alias in keyring.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

keyring_wiring.description: Per-alias keyring fields another module's outputs fill, merged over the keyring entry of the same alias (LIB-0043 §4): a bucket's name, and an API key's access_key_id and secret_key. A null field leaves the entry's own value. Every key must be an alias in keyring.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

post_provision_commands.description: Commands to run once, in order, as a self-disabling systemd oneshot unit ordered after cloud-init's own completion (cloud-final.service) rather than blocking it (ADR-0125). Inspect output with `journalctl -u pigeon-post-provision.service`. Defaults to [] -- nothing extra runs.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

self_delete_credentials.description: IAM credentials the self-delete trap authenticates as. ADR-0153 moved minting these to the caller (pigeon-cluster composes an iam-policy/iam-api-key pair per job, kept separate from the job's own work credential so the keyring key never carries InstancesFullAccess). Ignored unless self_delete_on_exit is true. Note that rotating this key changes the rendered cloud-init, which replaces the server.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

self_delete_on_exit.description: Prepend a trap to the post-provision script that deletes this instance (with its IP and volumes) when the script exits, whether it succeeded or failed (ADR-0138). The instance discovers its own ID and zone at runtime from the Scaleway metadata service, so no Terraform-side instance reference is needed. Requires self_delete_credentials.
